title: Catering Request

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Takeout! Swing by to 'take' something else outta my bag?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Takeout! Swing by to 'take' something else outta my bag?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: If you're trying to take pictures or get a clip, they already hauled them away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're trying to take pictures or get a clip, they already hauled them away.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where'd they take them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where'd they take them?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: See those ferns? Bloke didn't realize they were contortix blossoms. Shoulda seen how quick the bots mopped his puke up off the floor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See those ferns? Bloke didn't realize they were contortix blossoms. Shoulda seen how quick the bots mopped his puke up off the floor.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Poison control, probably. I did my emergency assessment and deemed him stable enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Poison control, probably. I did my emergency assessment and deemed him stable enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gnarly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gnarly.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Pretty mellow actually. Least compared to what dispatch told me when the alert came through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pretty mellow actually. Least compared to what dispatch told me when the alert came through.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What'd they tell you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What'd they tell you?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Someone tried to tongue-fuck the front end of a train. Was looking forward to it too. Haven't had a good trauma call in a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone tried to tongue-fuck the front end of a train. Was looking forward to it too. Haven't had a good trauma call in a while.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's gross.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's gross.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wicked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wicked.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Whatever. To each their own. So, if you're not a fatality freak, then what are you doing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. To each their own. So, if you're not a fatality freak, then what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Right? So, one fatality freak to the next, if you aren't here for that then why are you here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right? So, one fatality freak to the next, if you aren't here for that then why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Supposed to fix a catering issue. Think I got played though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Supposed to fix a catering issue. Think I got played though.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Supposed to fix a catering issue. Think I got played though.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Supposed to fix a catering issue. Think I got played though.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can explain...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No idea what you're talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No idea what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever. Listen, in all honesty it is what it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, yeah, whatever. Listen, in all honesty it is what it is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait... Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait... Really?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Yeah. I mean, all I needed to do was log a 1044 form and report the BioX-50 lot number.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. I mean, all I needed to do was log a 1044 form and report the BioX-50 lot number.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh. Cool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh. Cool.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Not for the bloke who needed a dose, couldn't get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not for the bloke who needed a dose, couldn't get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure karma will get me at some point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure karma will get me at some point.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure karma will get me at some point.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure karma will get me at some point.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: His spleen ruptured. Kinda ironic if you think about it. Body is meant to keep us alive and his killed him. Ha! I probably shouldn't laugh at that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His spleen ruptured. Kinda ironic if you think about it. Body is meant to keep us alive and his killed him. Ha! I probably shouldn't laugh at that.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Judging by the look of yah it already has.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Judging by the look of yah it already has.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whoa.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, well you're the one who took the stuff soooooo. Now, before I get another call, what did you come here to take?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, yeah, well you're the one who took the stuff soooooo. Now, before I get another call, what did you come here to take?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Fuckin' Ziggy. That dude is going to be the death of me. And his party guests.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuckin' Ziggy. That dude is going to be the death of me. And his party guests.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you actually a caterer too?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you actually a caterer too?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you actually a caterer too?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you actually a caterer too?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Listen, I cater, but party favors are different than party food. I told Zig where to find his gift bag but he shunned me since I told him I wasn't going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, I cater, but party favors are different than party food. I told Zig where to find his gift bag but he shunned me since I told him I wasn't going.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where'd you leave it for him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where'd you leave it for him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where'd you leave it for him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where'd you leave it for him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why didn't you give it to him in person?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why didn't you give it to him in person?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why didn't you give it to him in person?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why didn't you give it to him in person?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why aren't you going to his party?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why aren't you going to his party?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why aren't you going to his party?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why aren't you going to his party?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Pffftt. Have you ever been to a Ziggy party, takeout?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pffftt. Have you ever been to a Ziggy party, takeout?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Hahaha. Oh boy. Well, you're in for a treat. I'll give it to him, he's fun. Also really good for business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha. Oh boy. Well, you're in for a treat. I'll give it to him, he's fun. Also really good for business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How so?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Zig likes his parties. Likes everyone to have a good time and he'll go to lengths to make sure it happens.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Zig likes his parties. Likes everyone to have a good time and he'll go to lengths to make sure it happens.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My name is not takeout.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My name is not takeout.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems intrusive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems intrusive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nice of him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice of him.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Yeah, kinda like the time he spent twenty thousand Lims on a party for his buddy to propose to his girlfriend at.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, kinda like the time he spent twenty thousand Lims on a party for his buddy to propose to his girlfriend at.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Damn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He could throw me a party.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He could throw me a party.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He could throw me a party.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He could throw me a party.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Exactly. Then we all found out he was actually banging the girl behind said buddy's back. So, you know, there is that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. Then we all found out he was actually banging the girl behind said buddy's back. So, you know, there is that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For 'Sec's sake.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For 'Sec's sake.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Mhm. Here's where you can find the party favors. My advice? Go slow. Have fun, takeout.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhm. Here's where you can find the party favors. My advice? Go slow. Have fun, takeout.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Ughhh, because then I'd be complicit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ughhh, because then I'd be complicit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What exactly is in the bag?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What exactly is in the bag?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What exactly is in the bag?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What exactly is in the bag?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Smart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Smart.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Haven't stayed alive this long by being dumb. Situational awareness my friend. Situational awareness. Ah, shit, that's an alert from dispatch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haven't stayed alive this long by being dumb. Situational awareness my friend. Situational awareness. Ah, shit, that's an alert from dispatch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A good one?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A good one?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Damn, you really are a trauma junkie.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn, you really are a trauma junkie.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just being aware of the situations around me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just being aware of the situations around me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just being aware of the situations around me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just being aware of the situations around me.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Straight to business, huh? Don't wanna hang around and chat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Straight to business, huh? Don't wanna hang around and chat?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Made a deal I'd do this ASAP.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Made a deal I'd do this ASAP.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Made a deal I'd do this ASAP.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Made a deal I'd do this ASAP.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh boy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh boy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can we focus on the catering?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can we focus on the catering?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can we focus on the catering?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can we focus on the catering?
